body.name: Equal-share three-group, three-period law
body.construction: Set \(K=1\), \(T=3\), \(J=2\), and \(P(G=g)=1/3\). Conditional untreated mean paths for groups one, two, and three are \((0,0,0)\), \((-1,-2,-2)\), and \((1,2,2)\). Let \(Y_t(0)=\mu_{G,t}+\varepsilon_{G,t}\), with \(\varepsilon_{g,t}=\sigma_{g,t}U_{g,t}\), where the \(U_{g,t}\) are independent Rademacher variables and \((\sigma_{1,1}^2,\sigma_{1,2}^2,\sigma_{1,3}^2)=(1,1,1)\), \((\sigma_{2,1}^2,\sigma_{2,2}^2,\sigma_{2,3}^2)=(1,1/2,1/2)\), and \((\sigma_{3,1}^2,\sigma_{3,2}^2,\sigma_{3,3}^2)=(2,2,2)\). Thus the two control-change variances are one and four. Set \(Y_3(1)=Y_3(0)+\tau^{\star}\) in group one and impose no anticipation.
